findings.title: State revokes trauma center designation for Vista Medical Center East in Waukegan for 2nd time in less than 3 years
findings.exact_supporting_passage: The state revoked the trauma center designation for Vista Medical Center East in Waukegan Friday
findings.access_consequences: Illinois Department of Public Health revoked the Level 2 trauma-center designation effective October 23, 2026. EMS agencies must update trauma-destination protocols; ambulances with seriously injured patients must use other, farther trauma centers. This is a separate, confirmed downstream loss beyond the previously recorded October 22 anesthesia-service suspension.
findings.affected_population: Patients with serious traumatic injuries requiring ambulance transport in Waukegan and nearby Lake County communities.
